title: K-HATERS: A Hate Speech Detection Corpus in Korean with Target-Specific Ratings

bias_targets.target: Demographic and social bias (Gender, Age, Race/Origin, Religion, Politics, Job, Disability)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model fairness by calculating the difference in equalized odds ratios (True Positive Rate and False Positive Rate) across multiple protected hate speech target groups to see if the classifier has similar error rates across them.

Assessing the impact of annotators' implicit cognitive biases and noise by administering the Cognitive Reflection Test (CRT), and subsequently comparing the fairness (equalized odds differences) and accuracy of models trained on labels from annotators with high versus low CRT scores.
